title: Mummy Pig's Birthday
hook: 妈妈生日这天，全家偷偷准备惊喜，还把妈妈“请”出门散步，就等蛋糕出场。

cells.a: He said, “Quick! We have to get everything ready!”
cells.cn: 他说：“快点！我们得把东西都准备好！”

cells.a: She asked, “It's Mummy. Can I come in?”
cells.cn: 她问：“是妈妈，我能进来吗？”

cells.a: She pretended she did not know where the sitting room was.
cells.cn: 她装作不知道客厅在哪儿。

cells.a: The birthday cake was ready for Mummy Pig.
cells.cn: 妈妈的生日蛋糕准备好了。

cells.q: What did the family tell Mummy?
cells.a: They said, “Bye bye! Have a lovely walk!”
They were doing secret things for her birthday.
cells.cn: 他们在为生日偷偷准备东西。

cells.a: They asked, “Can you guess what it is?”
He said Granny and he would baby-sit the little ones.
cells.cn: 他说他和奶奶来照看孩子们。
